text_block_list.text:
The day of the Yasuda Kinen.
Matikanetannhauser waited for post time while opening the milk pudding she brought along.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Nfufu, jiggly wiggly sweet little pudding~ Looks so delicious!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me, Ikuno is running
in today's Yasuda Kinen too, right?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to it~ Maybe I'll drop by the waiting room later.
(Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you today, Tannhauser-san.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno! Speak of the devil.
Looking forward to working with you too!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let us both prioritize our safety
and give it our absolute all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? That's—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's up?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...That milk pudding, by any chance,
was it the one kept in the dorm refrigerator?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yep, exactly!
I saved it for my snack today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Please wait! If my memory serves me right,
the expiration date passed five days ago!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh!? No way!?

I hurriedly checked the expiration date...
Sure enough, it expired five days ago!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, my stomach almost got wrecked!
Thanks, Ikuno!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No.
It was a coincidence, but I'm glad I came by to say hello.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"It would be quite troublesome if an important rival
were to collapse before the race, after all."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Right. Just in case, let's check
the condition of your horseshoes as well."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I-Ikuno, you're so sweet...!
